title: MAgnetic Gastrointestinal Universal Septotome: a Safety and Feasibility Study (MAGUS)
brief_summary: A novel magnetic device, called MAgnetic Gastrointestinal Universal Septotome (MAGUS) was designed to improve the Treatment of diverticulum of the esophagus, Pseudo-diverticulum of the upper GI tract, Candy cane syndrome This study aims to evaluating the safety of the feasability of this new device.
